name: us030-guard-not-a-hole
description: 030 C5.4/C5.5: the whole connection-settings.md §5.4 cross-check table in one scenario — email at another config.yml key, email at config.yml's exempt base_url key (still refused by field validation), a host at another personal.yml key, a host at personal.yml's exempt email key (still refused by field validation), host/email at config.local.yml (no exemption there), and ATATT at the exempt base_url key (C5.3: the token shape is NEVER exempt). Six sequential runs sharing one workdir; each refuses (exit 4), zero writes, and the value itself never appears in stdout. Byte-identical across ports proves the exemption is not a hole on either.
